tei:div.tei:p: (ca)༄༅// bka' gdams lha bzhi'i nyams len thar lam sgron me zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// oṃ swa sti/ snyigs dus gdul dka'i lus can kun// 'dren mdzad thub dbang la btud de// stong nyid snying rje zung 'jug gi /nyams len snying por dril te spel// de'ang mnyam med jo bo chen pos 'brom ston rin po cher stsal ba'i thugs dam lha bzhi'i nang tshan bcom ldan 'das thub pa'i dbang po'i lta khrid kyi nyams len la gsum/ sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so// dang po la gnyis/ thun mong dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa'o// dang po ni/ sngon 'gro skyes bu chung ngu'i lam bsod nams cha mthun gyi dge rtsa bsags pa/ skyes bu 'bring gi lam thar pa cha mthun gyi dge rtsa bsags pa/ skyes bu chen po'i lam phar phyin drug dang bsdu dngos bzhi la bslab pa/ de dag blo ldog rnam bzhir sbyar ba'i tshul rnams khrid yig las 'byung ba bzhin nyams su blang*/ gnyis pa la lnga/ lam gyi rtsa ba/ mthun rkyen rdzogs pa/ 'gal rkyen sbyong ba/ byin rlabs 'jug pa/ mtshan bcas kyi rnal 'byor ro// dang po la gnyis/ skyabs 'gro dang*/ sems bskyed do// dang po theg pa thams cad kyi rtsa ba skyabs 'gro ni/ skyabs yul dag pa'i zhing gi dbus su seng khri pad zlar rtsa ba'i bla ma dang dbyer med pa'i thub dbang sprul sku'i rnam pa can la rtsa gsum chos skyong gis bskor nas bzhugs par mos la/ rang dang pha ma mkha' khyab sems can thams cad sgo gsum 'jug pa gcig pas byang chub ma thob bar du skyabs su 'gro ba'i bsam pas/ bdag dang 'gro ba sogs sam/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs ma ji nus bsag gnyis pa theg chen thun mong ma yin pa'i rtsa ba sems bskyed pa ni/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho las bsgral te myur du bla na med pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du bdag gis lam zab mo nyams su blang bar bgyi'o snyam pa'i blos tshig ris 'di'am bdag gis sbyin sogs la sogs brjod cing*/

mthar tshangs gnas bzhi la blo bzhag ste/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang sogs tshad med bzhi bsgom/ gnyis pa mthun rkyen tshogs bsag pa maṇ+ḍal ni/ gong gi skyabs yul bsdus na slar gsal 'debs pa'am/ de nyid ma bsdus te tshogs zhing du byas pa'i mdun/ ngo bo rang gzhan thams cad kyi lus longs spyod dus gsum bsags pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad/ rnam pa gling bzhi ri rab lha mi'i dpal 'byor ma tshang ba med pa/ zhing khams rgya mtsho'i rdul gyis grangs dang mnyam pa/ rgya tshad med pa/ dus 'khor ba ji srid ma stong kyi bar du mchod yul la phul ba'i bsams pas tshig ris so bdun ma dang*/ sa gzhi spos byugs sogs kyis dngos su maṇ+ḍal ci nus phul ba tshogs zhing rnams kyis bdag gir mdzad/ bdag gzhan thams cad kyi tshogs gnyis rdzogs te da lta nyid du 'tshang rgya nus pa tsam du mos/ mthar tshogs zhing rang la bsdu'o// gsum pa 'gal rkyen sdig sgrib sbyong ba rdor sems sgom bzlas ni/ rang tha mal pa'i spyi bor pad zla'i steng du bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po rdor dril 'dzin cing longs sku'i chas can/ zhabs sems skyil du bzhugs pa'i mthe bong g.yas rang gi smin mtshams reg pa/ de'i thugs kar pad zla la hūm̐ dkar po'i mthar yi ge brgya pa'i sngags phreng dkar pos bskor bar mos pa rten gyi stobs/ sngar byas kyi sdig ltung rgyu dang bcas pa la 'gyod cing gdung ba'i blo drag po bskyed pa sun 'byin pa'i stobs/ 'gyod pa des drangs te/ bla ma rdo rje sems dpas bdag gzhan sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib nyes ltung thams cad sbyang bar mdzad du gsol snyam pa'i mos gus rtse gcig pas gsol 'debs kyi tshul du yig brgya bzlas pas thugs rgyud bskul/ sngags 'khor las bdud rtsi babs/ zhabs g.yas pa'i mthe bong brtol te rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs/ lus phyi nang thams cad bkrus/ thog med nas bsags pa'i sdig ltung bag chags dang bcas pa dag par mos pa gnyen po kun tu spyod pa'i stobs kyis bzla/

mthar/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpas bdag gzhan sems can gyi sdig sgrib nyes ltung thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas rdor sems 'od du zhu/ rang la thim pas lus zag med lha'i sku/ sems rtogs med chos kyi skur gyur par mos te mnyam par bzhag phyin chad srog la bab kyang mi dge ba la mi 'jug pa'i bsam spyod la gnas pa ni nyes pa slar lon gyi stobs te de dag dang ldan pa ni sdig pa sbyong ba'i gnyen po'i mchog go /bzhi pa byin rlabs 'jug byed bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni/ gong skyabs yul ltar bla ma dang dbyer med pa'i thub pa'i dbang po mtshan dpe'i gzi 'od 'bar ba la/ rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma sogs skyabs yul yod dgu cog thim pas dkon mchog kun 'dus kyi ngo bor mos la/ gdung shugs drag po dang bcas/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo dpal ldan bla ma rin po che la gsol ba 'debs so// bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ byams pa dang snying rje byang chub kyi sems rgyud la skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba drag la yun ring bar btab/ slar yang mos gus drag pos bla ma'i thugs rgyud bskul/ de nyid 'od du zhu/ rang la thim pas bla ma'i sku gsung thugs dang rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dbyer med du gyur te dbang gi ye shes rgyud la skyes par mos la bzo med kyi rang ngo bskyang ngo*// lnga pa mtshan bcas kyi rnal 'byor thub pa'i sgom bzlas ni/ swa bhā was stong par sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las seng ge brgyad kyis bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri'i steng du pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la rang gi sems nyid kyi ngo bo hūm̐ ser po de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa sku mdog gser btso ma'i mdog lta bu/

zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas sa gnon g.yon mnyam bzhag mdzad pa/ chos gos rnam gsum gsol zhing mtshan dang dpe byad kyis spras pa/ sku las skyes pa'i 'od kyi phung po'i klong na zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ zhes dam tshig pa bskyed/ de'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon pos mtshan par bsgoms pas gnas gsum byin gyis brlab/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ ces ye shes pa gzhug slar yang 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha spyan drangs/ oṃ pañca ku la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñca tu mām̐/ zhes gsol ba btab pas rigs lnga'i thugs ka nas sprul pa'i lha mo bzhis bdud rtsi'i bum pas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur bas dri ma dag lus bdud rtsis gang*/ lhag ma yar lud pas mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan par gyur/ ces rgyas gdab pa ste yan lag bzhi rdzogs kyi lha'i sku snang la rang bzhin med par gsal ba la ci nus su mnyam par bzhag des skyo na bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ thugs kar zla ba'i steng du mum̐ yig gser gyi kha dog can gyi mthar nang skor la/ oṃ mu ni mu ni ma hā mu na ye swā hā/ bar skor la/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ ga te ga te pā ra ga te pā ra saṃ ga te bo dhi swā hā/ mtha' skor la ye dharmā'i sngags phreng kha dog ser pos bskor bar bsam/ de las 'od 'phros lus gang*/ sdig sgrib sbyangs/ don gnyis byas/ sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi byin rlabs 'od zer gyi rnam pas rang la thim par bsams la sngags mu ni gtso bo// de'i sum cha ga te/ brtan byed ye dhar kha shas bcas kyi bzlas pa song nas/ spro na mchog bstod mdor bsdus bya/ lhar snang yang stong nyid du sbyang*/

'od gsal gyi ngang la sems ci gnas su bzhag mthar dge ba bsngo'o// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ thabs kun rdzob byang sems bsgom pa dang*/ thabs byung don dam byang sems bsgom pa'o// dang po la bzhi/ byams pa bsgom pa/ snying rje bsgom pa/ de dag gi bogs 'don/ byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa'o// dang po ni/ rang gi rtsa ba'i ma la dmigs te/ 'dis bdag la phan tshad med pa btags/ gnod pa sna tshogs las bskyabs pa sogs don che ba'i rgyu mtshan sgo du ma nas bsams la byams pa drag tu bsgom/ ma 'di bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig snyam pa dung dung bya/ de la 'byongs nas dgra sogs sems can thams cad la bsgom mo// gnyis pa ni/ ma 'dis 'dod pa bde ba 'dod kyang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu 'ba' zhig bsgrubs pas de dang 'bral 'dod kyi snying rje shas mi bzod pa tsam du bsgom zhing*/ sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig snyam pa dang mi 'bral bar bya/ gzhan gong bzhin/ gsum pa ni/ lus tsog pu/ lag gnyis 'gram pa skyor/ srin lag khar 'dzud/ gong ltar byams snying rje shugs lhag par bskyed cing*/ nga'i a ma zhes mang du brjod do// bzhi pa ni kun rdzob byang sems bsgom pa ste/ snying rje'o snyam du bzhag pas mi chog 'di rnams sdug bsngal las bsgral/ bde ba'i mthar thug sangs rgyas la dgod dgos/ de'i nus pa bdag la med pas thog mar lam zab mo bsgom pa la sogs pa sangs rgyas thob pa'i rgyu byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rlabs po che la bslab par bya'o snyam pa dngos gzhi dang*/ yan lag tu bde sdug gtong len gyi dmigs pa rlung dang sbyar zhing*/ 'od dkar nag gi rnam pas spro bsdu bya ba'am/ re dogs med pa'i snying rje gnad du che'o// gnyis pa la gsum/ zhi gnas bskyed pa/ lhag mthong btsal ba/ de gnyis zung 'brel du bskyang ba'o// dang po la gsum/ lus kyi gnad/

sems kyi gzhag thabs/ nyams ngos bzung ba'o// dang po ni/ bde ba'i stan la lus bsam gtan gyi chos bdun dang ldan par byas la/ dbugs 'byung rngubs gnas gsum nyer gcig tu bgrang*/ gnyis pa la gsum/ rten bcas/ rten med/ ngo bo nyid la 'jog pa'o// dang po la ma dag pa shing bu'am rde'u phra mo/ dag pa shāka thub sogs lha sku tshad ldan gyi dmigs rten la sems gzung*/ phyi ma la byings na gtsug tor/ rgod na skyil krung*/ snyoms na thugs kar gtad/ gnyis kar yang sems spro bsdu med par 'jog gsal na 'phro bcad cing yang 'jog pa sgrim klod ran pos ma yengs par bya/ gnyis pa ni/ de dag la goms nas dmigs rten mi bzhag par sngar bzhin yid kyis bsgoms la sems gtad/ 'di la sku'i cha shas re re la sems 'dzin pa dang*/ sku ril por sems 'dzin pa gnyis rim bzhin bya'o// gsum pa ni/ dmigs rten de dag gang yang yid la mi bya bar stong nyid kyi ngang du dgag sgrub bcas bcos med par cham mer bzhag pas yul yul can bsgom bya sgom byed sogs rtog pa'i 'phro 'du thams cad ma zhi'i bar nan tan chen pos zhi gnas snyoms 'jug la brtson/ gsum pa de las skyes pa'i nyams ngos gzung ba la gnyis/ gzhung dang*/ gdams ngag pa'i lugs so// dang po ltar na/ nyes pa lnga spong ba'i 'du byed brgyad bsten pas stobs drug gis yid la byed pa bzhi'i gnas skabs can gyi sems gnas dgu grub pa'i mthar shin sbyangs mi g.yo bar brtan pa la bya ste/ nyes pa lnga ni/ le lo dang ni gdams ngag rnams// brjed dang byings dang rgod pa dang*// 'du mi byed dang 'du byed de// 'di dag nyes pa lngar 'dod do// zhes gsungs pa'i don bsgom mi nus pa dang bying rgod gnyis su 'dus la/ de spong ba'i gnyen po 'du byed brgyad ni/ rtsol ba/ 'dun pa/ rgyu dad pa/ 'bras bu shin sbyangs bzhi le lo'i gnyen po/ gdams ngag mi brjed pa/

bying rgod byung ma byung rtog cing sel thabs la 'bad pa/ gnyen po 'du mi byed pa/ bsam gtan skyon med pa'i tshe 'du byed pa ste so so'i gnyen po la bslab/ stobs drug ni/ thos bsam/ dran shes bzhin/ brtson 'grus 'dris pa'i stobs te de dag gis sems gnas dgu rim bzhin 'grub bo// yid byed bzhi ni/ bsgrims te 'jug pa/ chad cing 'jug pa/ chad pa med par 'jug pa/ lhun gyis grub par 'jug pa ste 'di dag kyang sems gnas dgu la rim gyis 'jug go /sems gnas dgu ni/ sems 'jog kun tu 'jog nges par 'jog nye bar 'jog dul bar 'jog zhi bar byed/ nye bar zhi bar byed/ rgyun gcig tu byed/ mnyam par 'jog pa ste dgu'o// gnyis pa gdams ngag pa'i lugs kyis nyams lngar 'chad de/ g.yo ba'i nyams/ thob pa'i nyams/ goms pa'i nyams/ brtan pa'i nyams/ mthar phyin pa'i nyams te dpe rim par dang po ri gzar gyi 'bab chu/ gnyis pa gcong rong gi chu bo/ gsum pa chu bo dal 'bab/ bzhi pa rgya mtsho rlabs bral/ lnga pa mar me rlung gis ma bskyod pa lta bu'i nyams rang gi sems la rim par 'byung ngo*// gnyis pa lhag mthong la gsum/ gang zag gi bdag med sgom tshul/ chos kyi bdag med sgom tshul/ de'i don ngo sprad pa'o// dang po ni/ 'khor ba skyed byed lta log thams cad kyi rtsa ba 'jig lta lhan skyes gang zag gi bdag 'dzin ni/ sems can thams cad la nga'o zhes snyam pa'i lhan skyes kyi ngar 'dzin te/ de bdag med par lta zhing sgom pa la dpyad 'jog gtso che ba'i lugs gnyis yod/ don du gnyis ka zung 'brel dgos med gtso che ba'i dbang du byas na/ dpyad sgom pas rgyu la dpyod pa rdo rje gzegs ma/ 'bras bu la dpyod pa yod med skye 'gog gi rigs pas rgyu 'bras kyi bdag med rtogs par mdzad cing*/ 'jog sgom pas/ gang zag gi bdag de phung po dang gcig du ma gang du grub brtags pas de gnyis gar ma grub cing*/

tha snyad du phung po'i tshogs pa la brten nas nga zhes btags pa tsam las don dam par rang bzhin gyis ma grub pa'i tshul la nges shes bskyed pa sngon du btang nas/ gnyis pa la/ gzung pa med pa/ 'dzin pa med pa/ spyi bkag pa'i tshul gsum/ dang po ni/ bdag ma grub pa de bzhin snod bcud phung khams la sogs pa bdag gir bzung ba'i yul drug rnams kyang rdul phran 'dus pa las byung bas rags pa ma grub/ rdul phran de'ang brtags na cha med du 'gyur bas phra ba ma grub/ mdor na chos thams cad rtog pas phar btags tsam las don rang ngos nas rdul tsam ma grub ste/ dper na bum pa gzhi ma grub pas de med pa'i snga logs su bum 'dzin gyi shes pa mi skye ba bzhin no// gnyis pa ni/ yul sna tshogs su 'dzin pa'i shes pa 'di'ang yul rang bzhin gyis ma grub pa la brten nas byung bas yul can shes pa nyid kyang bden par ma grub ste rmi lam gyi shes pa bzhin no// gsum pa ni/ gzung 'dzin dang yod med yin min sogs spros mtha' thams cad bkag zin pa'i shul gyi spros bral spyi tsam dang shes pa rang rig rang gsal tsam du yang bden par ma grub ste gnyis min gyi phung gsum shes bya la mi srid pa'i phyir dang*/ rang ngos nas spros pa thams cad nye bar zhi ba'i phyir ro// de dag gi dpyad pa rgyas par grub na sngar smros pa'i sa bon las spros te bya'o// gsum pa ni/ de ltar dpyad pa'i grub 'bras snang lugs kun rdzob kyi ngos nas thams cad rgyu rkyen rten 'brel las skyes pas med pa min la/ gnas lugs don dam gyi ngos nas bdag dang*/ ngo bo dang*/ rgyu dang*/ 'bras bu dang*/ rten 'brel dang*/ yul dang*/ yul can/ dngos/ dngos med/ snod bcud la sogs pa chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis grub pa med de rgyu rkyen las skyes pa'i phyir yod pa ma yin la/ de las gzhan du'ang grub pa med pa de nyid rnam thar sgo gsum gyi mtshan nyid can gyi zhi lhag dbyer med snang stong zung 'jug gi ting nge 'dzin du nges shes bskyed par bya'o// gsum pa zhi lhag zung 'brel du sbyang ba ni/

dpyad pas sgro 'dogs chod de yul rang ngos nas spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral zhing bsam gyis mi khyab pa la zhugs pa de'i tshe/ yul can dpyod byed nyid kyang bsam brjod las 'das pa dper na bud shing zad pa'i me ltar blo'i 'jug pa mtha' dag gnyug ma rang bzhin rnam par dag pa'i ngang du thim pas gnas lugs bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i dbyings su sems sems byung gi spros pa thams cad nye bar zhi ba ni mthar thug pa'i 'jog sgom ste/ de lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par 'jug pa na lus ngag yid kyi gnad ma 'khrul ba dang ldan pas mnyam gzhag rnam par mi rtog pa'i ngang du dang po hril gyis bsgrim/ bar du lhod kyis glod/ mthar rang so bzung la mnyam par 'jog rjes ni so sor rtog pa'i shes rab kyis bdag rang bzhin med pa lam du byas te bsgom mo// gsum pa rjes ni/ thun mtshams su bsam sgom bgyis pa las byung ba'i dge rtsa byang chub tu bsngo ba dang*/ gegs sel bogs 'don gyi rim pa khrid yig las shes par bya'o// ༈ /na mo gu ru ār+ya lo ke shwa rā ya/ gnyis pa spyan ras gzigs snying rje mkha' khyab kyi nyams len la/ sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum/ dang po sngon 'gro la thun mong dang thun min gnyis/ thun mong ba thub pa'i lta khrid ltar bya/ thun mong ma yin pa la lnga las/ dang po skyabs 'gro ni/ sa phyogs dag pa'i zhing khams su gyur pa'i dbus su dpag bsam gyi ljon shing rtse mo lngar gyes pa'i dbus mar seng khri pad zla'i gdan la bla ma spyan ras gzigs kha sar+pa ṇi'i rnam pa can la brgyud pa'i bla ma'i tshogs kyis bskor ba/ mdun gyi yal gar spyan ras gzigs sogs yi dam/ g.yas su sangs rgyas/ rgyab tu dam chos/ g.yon du dge 'dun/ bar mtshams rnams su mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams bzhugs par mos la/ bdag gzhan sems can thams cad sgo gsum gus pas skyabs su 'gro ba'i blos/

bdag dang sems can thams cad legs pa'i lam ston bla ma rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// dngos grub 'byung gnas yi dam lha la skyabs su mchi'o// sku gsum ngo bo sangs rgyas rnams la= zab zhi spros bral dam chos rnams la= sar gnas lam zhugs dge 'dun rnams la= 'gal rkyen kun sel srung ma rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// zhes dang*/ bsdu na/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs ma lan brgya stong du bsag gnyis pa sems bskyed pa ni/ sems can thams cad yid yul du byas te/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang la gzhag par bya/ de'i ched du 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi rnal 'byor zab mo nyams su blang bar bgyi'o snyam pas/ deng nas bzung ste 'gro rnams sangs rgyas bar// rang nyid zhi bde skad cig med par ni// smon pa dang ni 'jug pa'i bdag nyid du// nyin mtshan dge pa'i las la bskul bar bgyi// zhes sam/ bsdu na/ bdag gis sbyin sogs brjod/ gsum pa maṇ+ḍal ni lag len ltar legs par bshams nas tshom bu so bdun ma nas bdun ma'i bar gyis 'bul/ mthar/ sku las 'od zer byung*/ sdig sgrib dag 'gro kun dag pa'i zhing du gshegs/ slar mos gus kyi rkyen gyis skyabs yul 'od zhu rang la thim par mos/ bzhi pa rdor sems sgom bzlas ni/ stong pa'i ngang las pad zla'i gdan la hūm̐ dkar po las rang nyid rdo rje sems dpar gsal ba'i thugs kar zla ba la hūm̐ gi mthar yi ge brgya pas bskor ba las 'od 'phros lus gang sdig ltung dag par mos nas yig brgya ci nus bzla/ mthar mi dmigs par bzhag lnga pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni/ rang gi spyi bor seng khri pad zla'i gdan gyi steng du rtsa ba'i bla ma spyan ras gzigs dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas mchog sbyin/ g.yon pad dkar/ zhabs sems skyil/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ 'od zer mu med par 'phro ba'i gnas gsum yig 'bru gsum las 'od zer 'phros/

mchod 'os thams cad spyan drangs te thim/ yid kyis mchod/ skyon gyis ma gos sogs kyis bstod/ mos gus rtse gcig pas brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs dang*/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bla ma spyan ras gzigs la skyabs su mchi'o// zhes ci nus su bskyar/ mthar bla ma'i gnas gsum 'bru gsum las 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin can gyi rgyun babs/ rang gi gnas gsum du thim/ lus thams cad 'od zer bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis gang*/ sgo gsum gyi dri ma dag sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs/ mthar bla ma 'od du zhu/ rang la thim pas bla ma'i gsang gsum dang rang gi sgo gsum dbyer mi phyed par gyur par mos la rang ngo bskyang ngo*// gnyis pa la gnyis/ mtshan bcas lha sgom pa dang*/ mtshan med de kho na nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin sgom pa'o// dang po la gsum/ lha sgom pa dngos/ de la gsal snang 'don pa/ bzlas pas thugs rgyud bskul ba'o// dang po ni/ swa bhā was stong par sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi sems nyid hrīḥdakar po ring cha tsheg drag dang bcas pa de 'od du zhu ba las thig le dkar po gsum du gyur te/ de'ang dbus che/ g.yas g.yon gnyis chung ba/ de rnams yongs su gyur pa las gtso 'khor gsum du gyur pa ni/ dbus su rang nyid thugs rje chen po sku mdog dkar po gangs ri la nyi ma shar ba ltar kun nas dkar ba/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ zhal 'dzum pa'i mdangs dang ldan pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs dang 'od dpag med pa'i dbu rgyan can/ dbu skra phyed dpung pa g.yas g.yon gyi steng na mar 'phyang ba/ phyag dang po gnyis thugs kar thal mo sbyar ba/ g.yas gnyis pas mu tig gi phreng ba 'dren cing*/ g.yon gnyis pas at+pal dkar po snyan gyi thad kar 'dzin pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' can/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/

de'i g.yas su jo bo nor bu 'dzin pa sku mdog ser po zhal gcig phyag bzhi dang po gnyis thal mo sbyar ba/ g.yas 'og mas rin po che dbang gi rgyal po yu ba dang bcas pa bsnams pa/ g.yon gnyis pas rin po che'i 'bras kyi snye ma bsnams pa/ rin po che'i rgyan dang dar gyi na bza' can/ pus mo btsugs nas spyan gnyis jo bo'i smin phrag tu gzigs pa/ g.yon du jo mo yi ge drug ma dkar mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma rgyan cha lugs gtso bo dang mtshungs pa/ pus mo btsugs shing spyan gnyis jo bo'i thugs kar gzigs pa'o// gtso bo'i thugs kar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥdakar po/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas jo bo gtso 'khor gsum mdun gyi nam mkha'i gnas su oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ār+ya a ba lo ki te shwa ra sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ nas/ shab+da'i bar gyis mchod/ thal mo sbyar te/ jo bo thugs rje chen pos bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi don du phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba lan gsum btab pas dam tshig pa so so la thim par bsam/ gnyis pa la gnyis/ rtsa ba'i lha la gsal snang 'don pa dang*/ snying rje mkha' khyab kyi ting nge 'dzin sgom tshul lo// dang po ni/ de ltar gsal ba'i lha sku'i snang ba lam me ba de la sems gzung*/ de'i gsal snang ma shor ba'i ngang res 'ga' gdan nas gtsug tor bar/ res gtsug tor nas gdan gyi bar/ res spyan gyi dkar nag lta bu phra ba nas rags pa'i bar/ res rags pa phyag zhabs nas phra ba spyan gyi bar gsal gdab/ de dag brtan nas lha snang spyi la sems gtad de mthar ba spu'i bu ga tshun chad ma 'dres par shin tu gsal zhing blo rtse gcig pa la brtan pa thob par bya ste dmigs pa'i dngos gzhi'o// gnyis pa ni/ rang nyid pad zla'i steng na 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/

skus zhing khams thams cad du khyab cing zhing khams rab 'byams rgya mtsho sku la rdzogs par lam gyis gsal ba'i sku lus kyi ba spu'i sgo nyi ma'i 'od ces pa na/ byang chub sems dpa' bye ba khrag khrig du ma dang*/ gser gyi ri khri/ re re la'ang rtse mo khri nyis stong*/ rin po che'i khang bzangs skyed tshal rgyan bkod du mas brgyan pa yi ge drug ma'i chos sgra sgrogs pa/ ba spu de'i nang na'ang rgyal ba'i dbang po zhes bya ba'i ba spu'i khung bu na/ lha'i gser gyi ri brgyad khri rin po che'i brag ri ljon shing dag dang*/ zas gos lha'i rang bzhin las grub pa las byang chub sems dpa' dag longs spyod cing*/ yi ge drug pa'i chos sgra sgrogs pa/ ba spu de 'das pa na sman chen po zhes bya ba'i ba spu'i khung bu na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems bskyed ma thag pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong*/ rdo rje/ dngul/ gser/ in+d+ra nī la/ pad+ma rā ga margad/ shel gyi ri rtse mo brgyad khri yod pa/ dri za'i sil snyan gyi sgra las yi ge drug pa'i chos kyi dbyangs 'byin cing*/ gang sems thog mar bskyed pa'i byang chub sems dpa' de dag stong pa nyid dang mtshan ma med pa sems te/ kye ma'o zhes sdug bsngal skye rga na 'chi sogs la skyo bas skyil mo krung bcas te lus drang por bsrangs nas dran pa mngon par bzhag ste ri de dag la 'khod pa/ ba spu de'ang 'das pa na/ sna tshogs pa'i rgyal po zhes bya ba'i ba spu'i khung bu na/ rang sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong du ma me 'bar ba dang*/ char 'bebs pa sogs cho 'phrul sna tshogs ston cing*/ rin chen sna bdun las grub pa'i ri'i rgyal po brgya phrag stong dag la 'dod dgu 'byung ba'i dpag bsam gyi sdong po/ rtsa ba mu tig lo ma gser dngul/ me tog man shel las byas pa dag las rgyan cha du ma dang kā shi kā'i gos rnams 'phyang ba/ de 'dra ba'i ri rnams la rang sangs rgyas dag bzhugs nas gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis kyang yi ge drug pa'i sgrar ston pa/

thams cad kyi tha ma na ba spu'i khung bu rgyal mtshan gyi rgyal po na/ rin po che'i ri brgyad khri bzhi stong dang*/ dpag bsam dang tsan+dan dang bye ru'i shing de snyed yod cing rin chen 'bar ba'i khang brtsegs na/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku 'dzam bu'i gling du mngon par phyogs shing chos 'chad pa/ phar phyin drug yi ge 'bru drug tu ston par mdzad pa'ang bzhugs pa sogs/ mdor na skra tsam khyon la dus gsum tshad snyed kyi sangs rgyas byang sems bzhugs nas la las ni dam pa'i chos kyi bgro ba mdzad/ la las ni phar phyin drug dang ldan pa'i chos 'chad/ la las ni rdzu 'phrul rnam par rtse ba'i cho 'phrul ston pa thams cad kyang yi ge drug pa'i sgra dbyangs sgrogs shing de dag las byung ba'i 'od zer bye ba khrag khrig ba spu'i sgo bye ba phrag brgya nas byung ste/ 'gro ba drug gi sdig sgrib bag chags ma lus pa sbyangs/ kun kyang jo bo thugs rje chen po'i sku 'ba' zhig tu song nas yi ge drug pa'i sngags di ri ri bzla bar mos te rtse gcig dmigs pa'i ngang dang ma bral bar mnyam par 'jog go /bzhi pa ni/ de ltar bsgoms pas ting nge 'dzin la gsal snang thon pa'am bsgoms pas skyo na bzlas pa la 'jug ste/ rang gi thugs kar pad+ma dkar po 'dab brgyad kha steng 'og tu lta ba'i ltag sprod/ gyen lta'i dkyil du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i hrīḥyig dkar po/ de'i mtha' skor du oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ zhes pa'i sngags phreng dkar po g.yas skor du 'khod par mos la rang nyid kyis bzlas pa byas pas sngags kyi sgra sems can thams cad kyi rna bar lhang lhang byung*/ don skye med kyi ngang du 'jog bzhin du yi ge drug pa ci nus su bgrang*/ slar thugs ka'i sngags phreng 'od du zhu/ ngo bo yig 'bru la rnams pa 'od zer gyis tshul gyis spyi bo nas rkang mthil yan chad gang*/ nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad sang sang dag

'od zer phyir 'phros/ sems can thams cad la phog pas sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa sbyong bar bsam/ yang sngags phreng sngar ltar gsal btab cing bzlas pa dang 'od du zhu ba'i dmigs pa spel ma ji tsam nus pa bya/ mthar gong du bshad pa'i snying rje mkha' khyab kyi ting nge 'dzin bsgoms la bzlas pa ci nus byas te/ thun 'jog pa'i tshe yi ge rnams pad+ma ltag sprod la thim/ de hrīḥl thim par mos/ gnyis pa mtshan med kyi rnal 'byor ni/ thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros/ bcud kyi sems can la phog de 'od du zhu/ de las 'od 'phros snod kyi 'jig rten la phog de dag 'od du zhu/ mtha' nas 'dus te 'khor gnyis la thim/ de gnyis gtso bo la thim/ de gnyis yas mar nas zhu/ thugs ka'i hrīḥl thim/ de'ang 'a chung ra la/ de ha la/ ha mgo bo/ mgo bo gi gu/ de'ang 'od du yal ba'i ngang la ci gnas su bzhag mi gnas par 'phro bar brtsams pa na/ stong pa'i ngang las thig le gsum/ de'i dbus ma hrīḥ de las gtso 'khor gsum/ snod gzhal yas khang*/ bcud lha'i rang bzhin du mos/ 'di la ched du sbyang na/ slar bsdu zhing mnyam par 'jog ste slar ldang ba sogs sngar ltar bya'o// gsum pa rjes la gnyis/ rjes kyi rnal 'byor dngos dang*/ zhar byung gi rnal 'byor gzhan bshad pa'o// dang po ni/ thun 'jog pa na 'khor gnyis rang la thim/ rang phyag gnyis pa'i nga rgyal gyis gnas par bya'o// gnyis pa zhar byung gi rnal 'byor la gsum/ khyad par bde stong gi rnal 'byor/ thun mong byang sems kyi rnal 'byor/ lam gyi chad mthud 'pho ba'i rnal 'byor rnams ni khrid yig ltar shes par bya'o// ༈ /na mo gu ru ār+yā tā rā ye/ gsum pa 'phags ma sgrol ma rjes dran lnga'i nyams len la gsum/ sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so// dang po la skyabs 'gro sems bskyed gnyis/ dang po thun mong ba'i sngon 'gro gong ltar bsgoms nas skyabs su 'gro ba ni/

sa phyogs dag pa'i zhing gi bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa'i rang mdun dpag bsam shing gi sdong po yal ga lngar gyes pa'i dbus mar rma byas bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri dang pad zla'i gdan la bla ma 'od dpag med sprul sku'i rnam pa can la rtsa brgyud bla ma 'od dpag med kyi rnam pas bskor ba/ mdun du seng ldeng nags kyi sgrol ma la yi dam lha tshogs/ g.yas su sangs rgyas/ rgyab tu dam chos/ g.yon du dge 'dun/ mtha' skor du mkha' 'gro chos skyong gi tshogs bcas gsal gdab/ sems can thams cad yid yul du byas te/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs ma ci nus su brjod pas skyabs su 'gro/ gnyis pa ni/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad rje btsun sgrol ma'i go 'phang la 'god par bya/ de'i ched du lam zab mo nyams su blang bar bgyi'o snyam pas/ bdag gis sbyin sogs mang du brjod do// mthar skyabs yul bsdu tshul gong bzhin/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ rjes dran dngos dang*/ phyi nang gsang ba'i go bab bshad pa gnyis/ dang po la lnga/ skyabs gnas bla ma/ lus lha/ ngag sngags/ 'gro kun pha ma/ sems chos nyid du rjes su dran pa'o// dang po ni/ rang gi snying gar snang ba kun rdzob thabs kyi ngo bo snod kyi thig le ser po sran ma bkas pa'i dbyibs lta bu/ de'i steng du stong pa don dam shes rab kyi ngo bo bcud kyi thig le gser mdog 'od lnga 'phro ba yungs kar gyi dbyibs can che chung snod dang mnyam pa/ de'i steng du pad zla'i gdan la rtsa ba'i bla ma 'od dpag med sprul sku'i rnam pa can/ de'i spyi bo nas tho brtsegs su pad zla'i gdan chung ngu reg la ma 'byar bar re re'i steng du brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams 'od dpag med kyi rnam pa can du bzhugs pa/ thams cad kyi steng mar jo bo rje dngos bsgom/ jo bo'i dbu gtsug nas pad zla'i gdan gyi phreng ba kha gsum gyes pa'i dbus mar rdo rje 'chang*/

te lo/ nā ro/ ḍom+bi pa sogs nyams len byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa dang*/ g.yas mar byams pa thogs med sku mched sogs rgya chen spyod brgyud dang*/ g.yon mar 'jam dbyangs klu sgrub yab sras sogs zab mo lta brgyud rnams so so la thug gi bar phreng bar bstar te bzhugs pa/ de dag gi gnas gsum 'bru gsum gyis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros/ rtsa brgyud bla ma dang dkon mchog thams cad spyan drangs gnyis su med par thim pas dkon mchog kun 'dus kyi bdag nyid du mos nas/ phyag mchod sogs yan lag bdun pa'i dmigs rnam gsal btab nas/ bzang spyod nas 'byung ba'i yan lag bdun pa brjod/ de nas mos gus rtse gcig pas/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la gsol ba 'debs so// skyabs su mchi'o// byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes lan mang du gsol ba gdab/ rjes dbang bzhi blang tshul gong bzhin dang*/ mthar gong ma 'od du zhu ste 'og ma la rim bzhin thim mthar rtsa ba'i bla ma yang bde ba chen po'i ngo bor 'od du zhu nas snod bcud kyi thig le la thim/ de'ang mi dmigs pa blo 'das brjod bral gsal stong zung 'jug gi rang mdangs bskyang ngo*// gnyis pa lus lhar rjes su dran pa la gnyis/ lha skur sgrub pa dang*/ gsal snang la bslab pa'o// dang po ni/ swa bhā was stong par sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las sa phyogs dag pa'i zhing gi bkod pa tshad med pa seng ldeng nags tshal me tog 'bras bus brgyan pa'i ljon shing du mas gtibs pa'i dbus su/ pam̐ las pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du tām̐ las ut+pal ljang sngon tām̐ yig gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid rje btsun 'phags ma seng ldeng nags kyi sgrol ma sku mdog ljang ser zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/

g.yas mchog sbyin dang g.yon ut+pal sngon po'i sdong bu 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs dang*/ rin po che dang dar gyi na na bzas brgyan pa/ zla ba'i rgyab yol can/ dbu skra li ba/ zhal 'dzum pa'i mdangs can/ 'od dang 'od zer gyi rang bzhin can du gsal ba'i gnas gsum 'bru gsum dang*/ thugs kar zla ba la gnas pa'i tām̐ yig ljang gu/ de las 'od 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ lha dang lha min sogs kyis bstod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang 'od 'phros dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor bcas spyan drangs/ ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñca tu māṃ/ zhes gsol ba btab pas rigs lnga'i thugs ka nas yum bzhi bdud rtsi'i bum pa thogs pa byung ste/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs dang*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan par gyur/ spro na sngar ltar mchod bstod bya/ gnyis pa ni/ lha sku de nyid snang la rang bzhin med pa/ gsal la ngos gzung med pa/ bde la zhen pa med pa gsal lam mer yang nas yang du gsal btab la/ rnam pa spyi bye brag dang*/ rags pa nas phra ba'i gsal snang brtan por ma gyur bar bsgom mo// yang tām̐ las 'od 'phros don gnyis byas/ tshur 'dus rang la thim/ yang 'od 'phros snod bcud gzhal yas khang dang sgrol ma'i skur gyur par mos/ yang 'og 'jigs pa brgyad skyob kyi dmigs pa'ang 'dir blangs nas bsgom/ gsum pa ngag sngags rjes su dran pa la'ang gsum ste phyi dang nang dang gsang ba'o// dang po la gsum/ bsnyen pa sgrub pa las sbyor ro// dang po la bzlas pa'i gzhi 'god pa dang dmigs pa dngos so// dang po ni/

rang sgrol mar gsal ba'i thugs kar zla ba la tām̐ yig sngo ljang*/ de'i mthar yi ge bcu pa yig ngo nang du lta ba g.yas skor du 'khod par mos la gsal brtan du ma gyur bar bsgom/ gnyis pa ni/ sa bon sngags phreng dang bcas pa las 'od zer bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros/ lus thams cad gang*/ nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad sbyangs/ tshe bsod dpal 'byor rgyas/ 'od zer phyir 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas la mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul/ 'od zer tshur 'dus/ sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs thams cad thob par mos te yi ge bcu pa'i bzlas pa ci nus su bya ba ni bdag don byin rlabs kyi bzlas pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ sngags las 'od zer 'phros/ rigs drug gi sdig sgrib bag chags bsal/ snod bcud snang la rang bzhin med pa 'phags ma'i zhing khams rten dang brten par bcas par gyur/ khyad par ba spu'i bu ga nas rang 'dra ba'i sgrol ma nam mkha'i khams khyab par spros/ 'gro drug gi sdug bsngal rgyu bcas bsal/ bde ba'i gnas la bkod par bsams te yi ge bcu pa'i bzlas pa ci nus su bya ba ni gzhan don phrin las kyi bzlas pa'o// gsum pa ni/ 'jigs pa brgyad skyob kyi bzlas dmigs bya ba ste/ re re bzhin bzlas pas thugs rgyud bskul bas rang gi thugs srog sngags phreng dang bcas pa las 'jigs skyob so so'i sku mdog dang mthun pa'i 'od 'phros/ smin mtshams su sleb pa dang 'od kyi sne las so so'i sku dpag med 'phros pas mkha' khyab 'gro kun phyi nang gi 'jigs pa las dbugs phyung*/ tshur 'dus rang la thim par bsam pa thams cad la 'gre'o// 'jigs skyob so so la seng ge'i 'jigs skyob sgrol ma seng gdong mche ba gtsigs shing lce glog ltar 'khyug pa/ spyan ser mo mdog dmar zhing skra ser ba/ thugs kar mi 'jigs pa'i phyag rgya mdzad pa/ rgyan gyis brgyan pa sems can rnams nga rgyal seng ge'i 'jigs pa las sgrol bar bsam/

glang po'i 'jigs skyob sgrol ma glang gdong shangs mtho zhing mche ba gtsigs pa/ gsus pa 'phyang ba du ba'i mdog can/ mthe bong mngon par brkyangs pa phyag gnyis kyis bsdigs par mdzad pa/ sems can rnams gti mug glang po'i 'jigs pa las sgrol bar bsgom/ me'i 'jigs skyob sgrol ma dmar mo 'bar ba'i gdong pa can zhal bdun/ ljags bdun/ skra gyen du 'bar zhing*/ phyag gnyis kyi pad+ma'i phyag rgya mdzad cing rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ sems can rnams zhe sdang me'i 'jigs pa las sgrol bar bsgom/ sbrul gyi 'jigs skyob sgrol ma kha dog nag po sbrul mgo'i gdengs ka bcu dang ldan zhing skra grol ba/ rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ phyag gnyis kyis mi 'jigs sbyin pa'i phyag rgya mdzad cing*/ sems can rnams phrag dog sbrul gyi 'jigs pa las sgrol bar bsgom/ chom rkun 'jigs skyob sgrol ma sku mdog ljang gu zhal khro gnyer bsdus pa/ skra gyen du brdzes pa/ phyag g.yas ral gri g.yon sdigs mdzub/ rgyan gyis brgyan nas bzhengs pa/ sems can rnams lta ngan chom rkun gyi 'jigs pa las sgrol bar bsgom/ lcags sgrog 'jigs skyob sgrol ma sku mdog dmar mo g.yas dang g.yon pa lcags kyu dang zhags pa 'dzin cing rgyan gyis brgyan nas bzhengs pa/ sems can rnams ser sna lcags sgrog gi 'jigs pa las sgrol bar bsgom/ chu'i 'jigs skyob sgrol ma sku mdog dkar mo/ phyag g.yas lcags sgrog g.yon sdigs mdzub/ zhi ba'i skur bzhengs pa/ sems can rnams 'dod pa chu'i 'jigs pa las sgrol bar bsgom/ sha za'i 'jigs skyob sgrol ma sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ kun+da dang zla ba'i mdog can rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas mchog sbyin dang g.yon mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa'i phyag rgya mdzad cing*/ sems can rnams the tshom sha za'i 'jigs pa las sgrol bar bsgoms la/ re re la'ang mos gdung dang 'brel bar yi ge bcu pa bzlas la/

tā rā tā rā zhes gnyis kyi sngags 'di dang*/ mthar tā rā mkhyen ces brjod de/ gnyis pa nang gi bzlas pa la'ang gnyis/ thun mong dang khyad par ro// dang po thun mong 'bru gsum rdo rje'i bzlas pa ni/ rlung ro bsal/ rlung rtsol med rang bab kyis nang du 'jug pa oṃ dkar po/ gnas pa āḥdamar po/ phyir 'gro ba'i tshe hūm̐ sngon por mos la ci nus su bgrang ngo*// gnyis pa khyad par yi ge bcu pa'i rdo rje'i bzlas pa ni/ rlung ro bsal/ rlung rang bzhin gyis nang du 'jug pa yi ge bcu pa dkar po/ gnas pa yig bcu dmar po/ ldang ba yig bcu sngon por bsams la bgrang ba'o// gsum pa gsang ba'i bzlas pa la/ spyir ni sgra mtha'i bsam gtan zhes bya ba gong du ngag bzlas kyi skabs de dag gam dmigs bsal du'ang rung bar yig bcu'i sgra dril bu'am ting shag lta bu'i sgra mtha'i hā'i skad je phrar yal ba la sems gzhol ba dang*/ khyad par yi ge bcu pa'i thog mtha' bar gsum sems kyi gnas lugs stong pa nyid kyi ngo bo dang gnyis su med pa la sgra'i mtha' nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i rang bzhin la blo bzhag par gsungs so// rtsa ba'i bzhi pa 'gro kun pha mar rjes su dran pa la gsum ste/ byams pa bsgom pa/ snying rje bsgom pa/ kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa rnams ni thub pa'i lta khrid kyi nyams len ltar bya/ rtsa ba'i lnga pa sems stong par rjes su dran pa la gsum/ zhi gnas bsgom/ lhag mthong btsal/ de zung 'brel du nyams su len tshul rnams kyang gong ltar bsgoms pas don 'grub bo// gnyis pa rjes dran lnga po de rnams phyi nang gsang ba'i don dang sbyar te nges par bya ba'ang khrid yig ltar shes par bya'o// gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba la gnyis/ dngos dang zhar byung ngo*// dang po ni/ rang lhar bsgoms pa yin na bsdu rim dang*/ thun mtshams kyi lhar ldang ba/ gnas gsum bsrung ba sogs spyi ltar byas/

dkyus gcig tu bsgoms na byang sems kyis mtshams sbyar ba sogs mdor na thun mtshams la bab pa na/ theg pa chen po'i smon lam dang 'khor gsum yongs dag gi bsngo bas rgyas gdab ste/ spyod lam la 'jug pa'i tshe snang grags rtog gsum rje btsun 'phags ma'i gsang ba gsum gyi lam khyer dang ma bral bar bya'o// gnyis pa zhar byung stan thog gcig tu nyams su len tshul kyang khrid yig ltar ro// ༈ /na mo gu ru ār+ya a tsa lā ya/ bzhi pa mi g.yo ba chos drug gi nyams len la/ sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes gsum/ sngon 'gro la'ang lnga ste/ skyabs sems/ maṇ+ḍal/ yig brgya/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ tshogs gsag gi rnal 'byor ro// dang po skyabs 'gro la bsgom don/ dbus su bla ma mi bskyod pa sprul sku'i rnam pa can dang mdun du yi dam mi g.yo ba sogs/ ngag 'don sangs rgyas chos tshogs dang*/ maṇ+ḍal phul nas skyabs yul bsdu ba'i bar 'dor len cung zad las gong spyan ras gzigs kyi skabs bzhin/ rdor sems sgom bzlas gong thub pa dang*/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor rtsa ba'i bla ma mi bskyod sprul sku'i rnam par bskyed cing*/ gsol 'debs sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku sogs las gzhan spyan ras gzigs dang 'dra/ tshogs bsag la tshad med bzhi bsgom pa sngon du 'gro bas/ rang mdun nam mkhar pad nyi'i gdan gyi steng du hūm̐ sngon po thol gyis byung*/ de la sems cher gyis gtad pas de nyid 'od du zhu ste gtum chen mi g.yo ba sngon po sogs nas/ bzhugs pa'i bar 'og nas 'byung ba bzhin dang*/ de nyid sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bdag nyid du mos nas phyag mchod sogs yan lag bdun pa bzang spyod las 'byung ba dang*/ gsol 'debs/ jo bo mi g.yo bas bdag la dbang bskur du gsol/ gsang sngags mtha' dag nyams su len du rung ba'i snod du byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ ting nge 'dzin bzang po rgyud la skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/

bde stong zung 'jug gi rtogs pa bsam kyis mi khyab pa skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes mos gus drag pos lan mang du brjod cing gsol ba btab pas zhabs g.yas pa'i mtheb chen las bdud rtsi babs/ spyi bo nas zhugs/ lus gang*/ bde stong gi ye shes skyes/ mthar yig brgya brjod de rang la thim par bsam/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gnyis/ thun mong du lha'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa chos drug gi rnal 'byor ro// dang po la bzhi/ bskyed rim gsal snang dang bcas pa/ thun mong me dmigs/ khyad par gzigs stangs/ thun mtshams srung ba'i rnal 'byor ro// dang po ni// oṃ swa bhā wa sogs kyis stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma/ ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ sngon po/ de las 'od 'phros don gnyis byas/ tshur 'dus pa las skad cig gis rang nyid gtum po chen po'i lha'i skur wal gyis gyur pa ni/ sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas ye shes kyi ral gri 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon rdo rje'i zhags pa dang bcas pas thugs kar sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ dbu skra sma ra smin ma dmar ser gyen du 'bar ba/ dmar zhing zlum pa'i spyan gnyis 'khyug cing tshems kyis ma mchu mnan pa/ rin po che dang klu chen brgyad kyis brgyan cing sbrul dkar pos se ral khar byas pa/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs can/ g.yas bskums g.yon brkyangs pas bgegs kyi rgyal po glang po'i sna can gyi steng na brdzis pa/ sprul pa'i khro chung du ma'i 'phro 'du dang*/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de'i gnas gsum 'bru gsum gyis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros/ ye shes pa spyan drangs dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa dang dbyer med du gyur/ slar yang hūm̐ gi 'od kyis dbang lha spyan drangs/ mchod cing gsol ba btab pas bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis dbang bskur/ sku gang*/

dri ma dag spyi bor mi bskyod pa sprul sku'i rnam pas rgyas btab par mos la lha sku'i snang zhen la yun ring du sems gzung*/ rnam pa spyi dang bye brag re re nas sems 'dzin rim bzhin bya/ gnyis pa me dmigs gsum bsgom pa la/ rang lhar gsal ba'i thugs kar pad nyi la hūm̐ mthar sngags kyis bskor ba la me lce tsha ngar dang ldan pas dang po hūm̐ dang sngags phreng 'bar/ de las lus gang sdig sgrib bsregs par bsgom/ yang me cher 'bar bas sgo dgu dang ba spu'i khung bu nas mar myug myug byung bas phyi'i me rir 'dres pas mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad bsregs par mos/ yang 'bar bas 'dom gang tsam nas stong gsum bar mched pas bstan dgra gdug can nad yams kyi bdag mo sogs ring du bskrad par mos nas de dag gi skabs sngags/ oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa ces pa ci nus su bzla'o// gsum pa gzigs stangs la bslab pa ni/ rang khro bo'i mig g.yas steng du btegs par de'i nang du mam̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyis 'khor 'das gsal lam gzigs par bsam/ g.yon 'og tu gnon par a las zla bas thams cad stong nyid du gzigs par bsam/ yang mig gnyis thad dkar gtod pas spyan dbus ma byung bas spros bral zung 'jug gzigs par bsam/ bzhi pa srung ba ni/ thun bsdu ba'i tshe ril 'dzin rjes gzhig gis lha snang 'od gsal du bcug stong pa'i ngang las rang lus ye shes kyi ral gri me 'bar ba sngo sangs 'og gzhi nas tshangs gnas bar sleb pa'i nang stong par rang sems hūm̐ sngon por gsal ba la mnyam par bzhag mthar bsdu ldang gnas srung sogs spyi ltar ro// gnyis pa chos drug la/ dang po gtum mo'i sbyor ba ni/ skyabs sems bla ma'i rnal 'byor sngon du 'gro bas/ lus me thabs drug chings bya/ dngos gzhi la gnyis/ dang po rlung gi rnal 'byor ni/ rang mi g.yo bar gsal ba'i lus kyi stong ra dang*/ rkang mthil gnyis su ram̐ yig dmar ljang re gsal/

rlung ro bus steng 'og gi rlung dal gyis mnan cing rngubs pa dang rkang mtheb bskyod pa'i rkyen gyis ram̐ gnyis las me rlung byung*/ brla yi rtsa bo che brgyud lte 'og sleb pas srog rtsol thur sel 'dzom par sems gtad de dgang zhing gzhil/ mi thub na sangs kyis bus de ltar sbyor ba bzhi ldan gyi rlung bsgom/ gnyis pa gtum mo'i rnal 'byor ni/ lus gnad sngar bzhin la grims cha che bar byas nas/ lte 'og chos 'byung dmar nag zur drug pa'i dbus su a shad dmar po gsal/ rlung bzung bas rkang mthil gyi ram̐ las me byung*/ sum mdor 'dres pas chos 'byung dros/ a shad las me 'bar ba'i drod kyis lte ba'i 'khor lo nas rim par drod tsha 'ur gyis byung bar mos/ yang stong ra'i dbus rtsa ro rkyang dbu gsum gyi dbu ma yar mar sne spyi bo dang gsus pa'i gnyer po cher sleb pa/ ro rkyang gnyis yas sna spyi bo nas sna bug gnyis dang*/ mar sna lte 'og nas dbu mar tshud pa/ dbu ma'i yar snar ham̐ dkar po mgo bo thur bstan/ mas sner a dmar po mgo gyen bstan gnyis ka phyed nub tsam/ lte ba'i thad kyi dbu ma'i nang du 'khor lo dmar po rtsibs drug pa'i lte bar hūm̐ dmar po/ rtsibs drug la a shad dmar po re re/ mar sne'i a'i steng thad du ram̐ dmar po zhig bsam/ rlung ro bsal/ rlung kha sbyor du bzung bas ram̐ las me gyen du 'bar bas 'khor lo g.yas su bskor/ hūm̐ dang a shad las me tsha ngar 'bar bar bsgom/ rlung gtong dus dbu ma nas yar nas dbyibs su gtong*/ thun 'jog dus me ram̐ la bsdu/ de ltar brtson pas brtan pa thob pa na/ me lce rim par bsrings nas snying mgrin spyi bor sleb pas ham̐ g.yos drod kyi bde ba skyes/ hūm̐ dang ham̐ las 'bar 'dzag 'bros 'ded la sems gtad de bsgom/ de skabs bde drod skyes na mi rtog stong nyid kyi rgyas gdab bo// rjes spyod lam kun tu gtum mo'i dam tshig bsrung ba dang*/

'jam rlung bzung bzhin spyod lam rnams bya'o// gnyis pa rmi lam la bzung ba dang las sbyar gnyis las/ dang po ni/ nyin par rmi lam ngo shes pa'i dran 'dun yang yang gtong*/ nub mo smin mtshams su sa'i thig le ser por sems bzung zhing gnyid log des ma zin na chu me rlung gi thig le'i rang mdog la sems gzung*/ des ma zin na sngar bas nyin par gyi dran 'dun shugs drag la sbyar/ des kyang ma zin na/ nyal khar snying pad+ma 'dab bzhi'i dbus su zla ba la hūm̐/ mdun du a/ g.yas su nu/ rgyab tu ta/ g.yon du ra rnams sngo skya ste thog mar hūm̐/ de nas a sogs g.yas skor gyis gnyid du 'gro khar ra la sems gtad pas nges par zin par 'gyur ro// gnyis pa de dag brtan pa na sbyang spel sprul bsgyur sogs la bslab/ de'ang nyin par gang la goms pa'i dge sbyor dang lta bar bsre/ 'di'i grub don 'chi srid 'od gsal las rlung sems tsam gyi sgyu ma'i lha skur ldang ba'o// gsum pa sgyu lus la gnyis kyi/ dang po ma dag pa'i sgyu lus ni/ rang gi mdun du me long dang*/ chu snod bzhag pa la gzungs brnyan 'char bar mig dang sems yun ring gtad/ de nas rang lus phar bsre tshur bsre ru bsgom/ bstod smad byas pas chags sdang mi skye na mang po'i gseb tu sbyangs pas brtan na 'byongs pa'o// gnyis pa dag pa'i sgyu lus ni/ me long chu snod sngar bzhin la/ lha sku'i phyag mtshan sogs g.yas g.yon go ldog pa zhig rang gi rgyab nas me long du gzugs brnyan 'char bar byas la snang yang bden med du bsgom/ brtan na rang dang me long gi bar du lha sku yod par bsgom/ de'ang gong ltar bsres nas snang stong sgyu ma lta bur bsgoms pas rtags gsum khrid yig ltar 'byung ngo*// bzhi pa don dam 'od gsal la ril 'dzin rjes gzhig gnyis/ dang po ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros/ lus gang*/ lha sku stod smad na zhu ste hūm̐ la thim/

de'ang zhabs kyu nas nā da'i bar mi dmigs par bsdus te lta ba bskyang ngo*// gnyis pa ni snod bcud 'od du zhu nas rang la thim/ rang yang hūm̐ la bsdu ba sogs gong bzhin/ ngo sprod dang zhar byung zung 'jug gi rnal 'byor sogs khrid yig ltar shes par bya'o// lnga pa 'pho ba la gnyis/ sbyang ba dang*/ las la sbyar ba'o// dang po la gsum/ sku gsung thugs kyi 'pho ba'o// dang po lus gnad dang ldan pas rang lus lhar gsal ba'i stong ra'i dbus su rtsa dbu ma phyi dkar la nang dmar ba yar sne tshangs bug tu zug pa la ham̐ mgo bo thur bstan gyis bkag cing*/ mar sne lte 'og tu phug rdugs su yod pa snying gar smyug ma'i tshigs 'gag pa lta bu'i pad+ma'i gdan gyi steng du rang gi rlung sems kyi ngo bo mi g.yo ba'i sku tshon gang ba 'phar yed yed byed pa'i thugs kar hūm̐ sngo skya spus bris pa lta bu gsal/ de las 'od zer 'phros bla ma mi g.yo ba spyan drangs/ rang gi spyi gtsug tu bzhugs pa la yid kyis phyag mchod 'bul/ ye shes gong 'phor 'gyur ba'i gsol 'debs mos gus drag tu bya/ 'og sgo 'then/ tshigs pa bsrang*/ lag pa mnyam gzhag lte 'og tu bcar/ rlung ro bsal la/ rlung nang du mnan pas snying ga'i yi dam cung zad yar bteg par bsgom/ de bzhin bum can khug pa re res yar yar bteg pas mthar spyi bo'i ham̐ la reg reg 'dug par mos/ slar snying gar phab la rlung btang ba bcas de ltar rtags ma thon gyi bar du 'gro ldog spel mar sbyang*/ thun 'jog pa'i tshe tshangs bug ham̐ gis bkag yi dam snying gar brtan par bzhugs par mos/ gnyis pa ni/ lus gnad rlung sbyor dang ldan pas yi dam wal gyis bsgom/ oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūm̐ brjod pas chos thams cad sgra brnyan tsam du bsam/ phaṭa ces brjod pas sems nyid brag ca yal ba lta bur bsam/ gsum pa ni/ gzhan sngar sku'i 'pho ba bzhin la snying gar sku bsgom pa'i tshab tu rlung sems kyi ngo bo hūm̐ yig sngo skya 'og nas hi dmar pos 'degs shing*/

steng nas ka dkar po mgo thur bstan gyis gnon pa'i tshul du bsam/ rlung bzung*/ yid kyis ka zhes dal bur brjod pas kas yar 'then/ hi zhes drag pa'i tshul gyis brjod pas his 'phul nas rlung khug re re bzhin je mtho je mtho mthar ham̐ la reg reg 'dug ka zhes drag po yid kyis brjod pas des mnan te snying gar bab par bsam/ 'phros sngar bzhin sbyang ngo*// gnyis pa ni/ 'chi bslu sogs kyis mi zlog pa'i 'chi ltas byung ba na nyes byas la bshags sdom/ lus longs spyod la ma chags par mchod/ zhing khams su 'gro ba'i 'dun pa byed/ sngar dmigs gnad gang la goms cha che ba de gsal/ de'ang sku dang thugs gnyis las/ sku dang yig 'bru dbu ma'i yar sne'i ham̐ yig la bstim/ de nyid sku'am yig 'bru dang dbyer med du gyur pa spyi bo'i yi dam gyi thugs kar rgyangs kyis thim/ de nyid dag pa'i zhing du gshegs pa'am mi dmigs par 'jog pa gang bder bya'o// drug pa bar do la gnyis/ sbyang ba dang*/ las la sbyar ba'o// dang po ni/ tshogs drug gi yul du snang tshad thams cad bar do yin/ de'ang bden par ma grub snyam du nges shes bskyed la drag du bsgom/ blo 'byongs nas nges par bar do yin snyam du thag chod pa na/ sgyu lus 'od gsal sogs rang nyid gang la goms pa de dang bsres nas lam du khyer zhing gnad du gtang bar bya'o// gnyis pa ni/ 'chi khar gzhi'i 'od gsal 'char ba'i skabs lam gyi 'od gsal la ma goms pas 'od gsal ma bu 'phrod par ma gyur na/ srid pa bar do'i snang ba 'char bas skabs der sngar gyi goms stobs kyis rgyu byas te/ bar do la bar do yin par shes pa'i tshe gom 'dris gang la che ba'i dge sbyor dang bsres te lam du btang*/ khyad par snang ba thams cad mi g.yo ba'i sku/ grags pa thams tsaṇ+ḍa ma'i sngags/ dran rtog thams cad rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes su rgyas gdab par bya'o// rmi lam/
